values.note: 2026 rates for two adults: water/electric site $50, full hookup $70, tent site $35; each extra adult $5 a night, children 12 and under free. Credit cards carry a 3% fee.

fees.source: http://www.twinriversfamilycampground.com/Rates-and-Rules.html ('2026 RATES', 'Full hookup sites - $70.00 per night (includes two adults)', 'Water/Electric Sites - $50.00 per night (includes two adults)', 'Credit cards are charged an addtional 3% transaction fee'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bathhouse with hot showers; dump station; playground; Wi-Fi at the office only. Tube, kayak and canoe rentals and river shuttles; ice and firewood sold.

facilities.source: http://www.twinriversfamilycampground.com/About-Us.html ('We do have w/e sites with a dump station', 'a clean bath house with hot showers', 'Wi-Fi is available at the office') + Activities page (rentals, shuttles), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No online booking; reserve by phone (336-982-3456). Memorial Day, July 4 and Labor Day weekends need a three-night reservation. Check in by 10 pm; payment at check-in.

booking.source: http://www.twinriversfamilycampground.com/ ('Call us: 336-982-3456') + Rates-and-Rules page ('Memorial Day Weekend, July 4 Weekend and Labor Day Weekend will require a three night minimum reservation', 'Check-in is no later than 10:00 p.m.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Family campground on the South Fork of the New River in Crumpler, a 20-minute walk from the North/South Fork confluence. Riverbank fishing, swimming, and tube/kayak/canoe rentals with shuttles. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2026 rates ($50 water/electric - $70 full hookup, 2 adults), water/sewer hookups, dump station and the 3-night holiday minimum; added showers, phone booking. Note cleaned of hookup/bathhouse/dump text. Not stated: electric amperage, site count, season, any seasonal/long-stay sites (none mentioned).
flags: Price gate: base $50 (water/electric, 2 adults) sits at, not over, the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km (Asheville 151 km). Family has not stayed here.
Long-stay: the operator pages mention no seasonal, monthly or long-term sites - nightly rates only, so no seasonal share found.
